title: Romans
author: Paul the apostle.
audience: Believers in Rome, both Jewish and Gentile Christians.
historicalSetting: Romans presents the Gospel of God's righteousness revealed through faith in Jesus Christ.
keyVerse: Romans 1:16-17 — "For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ... the righteous shall live by faith."
christFocus: Romans centers on Christ crucified and risen as the only ground of righteousness, freedom from condemnation, and life in the Holy Spirit.
outline: Sin and righteousness by faith — Romans 1-4
New life in Christ and the Spirit — Romans 5-8
Living sacrifice and Gospel obedience — Romans 12-16
